matches.preview: Aston Villa are the model’s favourite, although the 49% home-win probability leaves considerable room for the draw at 26% and a Nottingham Forest win at 25%. Villa ended last season with consecutive victories, winning 2-1 away to Manchester City before a 4-2 home success over Liverpool. Forest’s final six league matches included three wins, two draws and one defeat, with away victories at Chelsea and Sunderland. Villa are also unbeaten in the three most recent meetings, winning twice before April’s 1-1 draw. The total-goals forecast is narrowly tilted towards over 2.5 goals at 51%, compared with 49% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Aston Villa，但主場獲勝機率為 49%，平手與 Nottingham Forest 獲勝仍有相當可能性，機率分別為 26% 與 25%。Villa 上季以二連勝作收，先在客場以 2：1 擊敗 Manchester City，接著在主場以 4：2 戰勝 Liverpool。Forest 最後六場聯賽取得三勝二和一敗，其中包括客場擊敗 Chelsea 與 Sunderland。Villa 在最近三次交手中也保持不敗，先取得二連勝，再於四月以 1：1 戰平。總進球數預測略微傾向超過 2.5 球，機率為 51%，低於 2.5 球則為 49%。

matches.preview: The model makes this a finely balanced contest, with Bournemouth narrowly favoured at 39%, compared with 34% for a Brentford win and 27% for the draw. Bournemouth ended last season unbeaten in six league matches, recording three wins and three draws, while Brentford’s final six brought one win, three draws and two defeats. The recent head-to-head record, however, leans towards the visitors: Brentford won four of the last five meetings, with the other ending 0-0 in March 2026. That contrast keeps the outcome uncertain despite Bournemouth’s slight model edge. For total goals, the lean is over 2.5 at 57%, against 43% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型顯示這是一場實力相當接近的比賽，Bournemouth以39%略占優勢，Brentford獲勝的機率為34%，平局則為27%。Bournemouth在上季最後六場聯賽保持不敗，取得三勝三和；Brentford最後六場則取得一勝三和兩敗。不過，近期交手紀錄較有利於客隊，Brentford贏得最近五次交手中的四場，另一場則於2026年3月以0比0收場。儘管模型顯示Bournemouth稍占優勢，這項反差仍使比賽結果充滿不確定性。總進球數方面，超過2.5球的機率為57%，低於2.5球的機率則為43%。

matches.preview: Chelsea are strong favourites, with the model giving them a 77% chance of winning, compared with 15% for the draw and 8% for Hull City. Chelsea’s closing run last season was uneven, featuring four defeats in six matches, although they also beat Tottenham 2-1 at home. Hull return to this level after finishing their second-tier campaign with one win in six, but they scored in five of those games. The historical head-to-head record favours Chelsea, who won all five listed meetings between 2014 and 2017. The total-goals lean is over 2.5 at 66%, against 34% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Chelsea 明顯較被看好，模型評估其獲勝機率為 77%，平手為 15%，Hull City 獲勝則為 8%。Chelsea 上賽季末段表現不穩定，六場比賽吞下四場敗仗，但也曾在主場以 2：1 擊敗 Tottenham。Hull 在次級聯賽賽季最後六場僅獲一勝後重返這一層級，不過他們在其中五場都有進球。歷來交手紀錄對 Chelsea 有利，他們贏下 2014 年至 2017 年間所列的全部五次對決。模型評估總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 66%，低於 2.5 球的機率則為 34%。

matches.preview_zh: 模型最看好 Crystal Palace，主場獲勝機率為51%，平局機率為26%，Ipswich Town 獲勝機率為23%。Palace 上賽季最後六場 Premier League 賽事未嘗勝績，取得兩場平局並吞下四場敗仗。Ipswich 本賽季重返 Premier League，因此他們在四月與五月的 Championship 賽果已成過往，不能視為目前的 Premier League 近況。不過，他們在那段賽程的最後一場以3比0擊敗 QPR。Palace 在2024至25賽季的兩次交手中，也都以1比0取勝。總進球數預測相當接近，全場總進球達3球以上的機率為51%，總進球不超過2球的機率則為49%。

The recent head-to-head record also leans towards Tottenham, who won the last two meetings without conceding. The total-goals forecast is completely balanced, with over 2.5 goals at 50% and under 2.5 goals also at 50%.

Even so, the totals forecast is cautious, with under 2.5 goals narrowly preferred at 53% against 47% for over 2.5.

matches.preview_zh: 模型略微看好 Manchester United，勝率為40%，Fulham 為32%，和局為27%，因此本場比賽仍相當勢均力敵。客隊在上季末段表現強勁，最後六場聯賽取得五勝一和，包括客場以3：0擊敗 Brighton。Fulham 在季末的表現較為起伏，但最後六場比賽仍有三場保持零失球。Manchester United 在近期五次交手中也贏得三場，Fulham 取勝一次，另有一場戰成平手。總進球數超過2.5球的機率略高，為53%，低於2.5球則為47%。
